authority.note: This file is a proposed retest delta only. It does not alter owner results or history.

definitionDeltas.change: Completed Activities are view-only. Remove the historical-Activity resume expectation; this is not a product repair.
Simulator data is local QA provenance and cannot assert personal truth. A standalone REAL Cairn creates one Personal Memory witness only after durable save at a frozen GPS fix with accepted accuracy.

END02.ownerObservation: Starting Run from Home inherited an already-running Hike; this was a blocker.
END02.rootCause: Hike and Run could both interpret shared live-session state without enforcing screen ownership.
END02.fix: A shared guard owns the active mode and redirects any sibling entry to the real session owner; mode is written only while idle.
END02.actionZh: 开始 Hike，返回 Home，再点 Run；分别在记录中和暂停时重复一次。
END02.expectedZh: 始终回到正在进行的 Hike；Run 不继承 Hike 状态，也不会创建第二个活动。

HOME03.ownerObservation: After pause, resume, and leaving Hike, Home still called it paused and named it Paused Hike.
HOME03.rootCause: Home inferred pause from navigation history instead of the canonical session state.
HOME03.fix: Home now reads the canonical live status and uses Recording/Paused plus one Return action.
HOME03.actionZh: 开始 Hike，先暂停再继续，然后回到 Home；再真正暂停后回 Home 对比。
HOME03.expectedZh: 继续记录时显示 Recording；只有真正暂停时才显示 Paused；返回活动不改变记录状态。

AUTH03.ownerObservation: Continue stopped responding after foreground resume; OTP needed manual handling; Auth flashed before Home; a Chinese waiting location appeared.
AUTH03.rootCause: Email entry depended on a delayed frame callback, navigation had competing owners, and location fallback was not guaranteed English.
AUTH03.fix: Email entry is synchronous, the root owns the single transition, OTP full-paste/AutoFill is retained, and the Home fallback is English.
AUTH03.actionZh: 在登录页快速切后台再回来，点 Continue with Email；粘贴完整 6 位验证码并完成登录。
AUTH03.expectedZh: 按钮立即响应；已有输入不丢失；验证码可整段粘贴/系统自动填充；进入 Home 无白屏、重叠或闪烁；等待位置只显示英文。

AUTH04.ownerObservation: In reset password, inserting a leading character erased the existing password; the keyboard covered the action.
AUTH04.rootCause: The reset field was not controlled consistently and the flow lacked keyboard-safe layout ownership.
AUTH04.fix: Password state is controlled; reset/forgot content uses keyboard avoidance, scrolling, and persistent taps.
AUTH04.actionZh: 在 Reset Password 输入 123123123，把光标移到最前面输入 g；保持键盘打开并滚动到提交按钮。
AUTH04.expectedZh: 文本变成 g123123123，不会清空；按钮可见、可滚动到并可点击。

CAIRN02.ownerObservation: The Plant button was completely obscured by the keyboard and keyboard behavior was inconsistent.
CAIRN02.rootCause: Plant content and its primary action did not share a keyboard-safe layout contract.
CAIRN02.fix: Plant uses the shared keyboard-aware container and maintains a reachable primary action.
CAIRN02.actionZh: 从 Home、Hike、Run 分别进入 Plant，聚焦文本框并保持键盘打开。
CAIRN02.expectedZh: Plant 按钮始终可见或可滚动到；点击空白和提交行为在三个入口一致。

CAIRN03.ownerObservation: Saved locally remained unsynced even after reconnect, app restart, and refresh.
CAIRN03.rootCause: Retry ownership was coupled to mounted screens and did not reliably drain on connectivity/foreground/hydration events.
CAIRN03.fix: App-owned connectivity plus bounded exponential scheduling now drains Cairn and Activity outboxes automatically.
CAIRN03.actionZh: 离线种一个真实 Cairn，确认显示本地保存；联网后等待自动同步。若仍离线，杀掉并重开 App 后再联网。
CAIRN03.expectedZh: 用户无需手动刷新；联网、前台恢复或冷启动后自动开始同步，成功后本地保存状态消失。

CAIRN10.ownerObservation: Activity Plant Back went to standalone location selection; simulated Plant split the route; simulator Activity/Cairn did not behave like Memory; standalone Cairn should prove a visit.
CAIRN10.rootCause: Plant lacked explicit caller identity, simulator provenance leaked into real persistence assumptions, and standalone visit truth was undefined.
CAIRN10.fix: Plant carries exact activity context; Back returns to that activity without route discontinuity. Simulator data is live local QA only. A durable REAL standalone Cairn adds one accurate GPS-anchored Personal Memory witness.
CAIRN10.actionZh: 用 Debug 模拟分别在 Hike/Run 中 Plant 后返回并继续走；打开 Memory 检查模拟轨迹。再关闭模拟，用真实 GPS 从 Home 单独 Plant。
CAIRN10.expectedZh: 活动内 Back 直接回原活动且路线不断；模拟路线在 Finish 前已显示并以模拟坐标进入 QA Memory；模拟数据不上传、不混入真实个人历史；真实独立 Cairn 保存成功后仅在准确 GPS 点解锁一次个人 Memory。

CAIRN08.ownerObservation: The simulator start lost its blue focus ring and Cairn overlays used inconsistent masks/styles.
CAIRN08.rootCause: The debug origin affordance and overlay presentation were not using the locked shared system.
CAIRN08.fix: The simulator origin ring is restored and Cairn sheets/dialogs use the canonical scrim and presentation family.
CAIRN08.actionZh: 开启 Debug 和模拟器，选择起点；在 Home、Hike、Run、Memory 打开 Cairn 和删除确认。
CAIRN08.expectedZh: 模拟起点有清晰蓝色焦点圈；遮罩、圆角、间距、关闭和操作层级在所有入口一致。

CAIRN01.ownerObservation: Detail map/content surfaces diverged in night mode; Plant Back and second-page title/spacing were inconsistent.
CAIRN01.rootCause: Standalone and activity callers had drifted layout and navigation contracts.
CAIRN01.fix: Plant caller context, navigation, title geometry, spacing, and Detail surfaces were unified against canonical components/tokens.
CAIRN01.actionZh: 日间和夜间分别从 Home、Hike、Run 完成一次 Plant，并打开详情。
CAIRN01.expectedZh: Back 语义正确；标题、上下区域、留白和颜色统一；夜间地图上方与详情面板不割裂。

CAIRN09.ownerObservation: Short notes made the sheet too thin; standalone source context was absent; Memory View Cairn did nothing and no Edit was available.
CAIRN09.rootCause: Detail sizing and action branches varied by renderer and assumed activity linkage.
CAIRN09.fix: Detail has a stable minimum body; linked Activities, unavailable links, and standalone planted dates are explicit; all Memory branches open real detail and expose allowed edit actions.
CAIRN09.actionZh: 打开短文字 Cairn、活动 Cairn、独立 Cairn，并从 Memory 地图点开后使用 View Cairn 和 Edit。
CAIRN09.expectedZh: 短内容不显得单薄；每个 Cairn 都有真实来源说明；View Cairn 有效；自己的 Cairn 可编辑。

CAIRN04.ownerObservation: All Cairns was sparse, used update time instead of planted time, lacked route-like filtering/sort, and did not distinguish personal/friend/public.
CAIRN04.rootCause: The list used mutation timestamps and overloaded one visual signal for author and audience.
CAIRN04.fix: All Cairns uses planted `createdAt`, actual audience filters, deterministic sorting, and shared authorship/audience labels.
CAIRN04.actionZh: 准备个人、朋友和 Public 样例，编辑一个旧 Cairn 后打开 All Cairns；切换筛选和排序。
CAIRN04.expectedZh: 编辑不会把种植日期改成 Today；筛选和排序正确；作者身份与可见范围均由图标加文字清楚表达。

CAIRN06.ownerObservation: Delete dialogs lacked the canonical close/keep pattern; Memory still used old UI; identity was indistinguishable; sync was too slow.
CAIRN06.rootCause: Delete UI and identity were duplicated, while offline retry waited on screen-local triggers.
CAIRN06.fix: All live callers use the shared delete dialog and identity line; automatic app-owned retry starts promptly after recovery.
CAIRN06.actionZh: 从详情和 Memory 各删除一个 Cairn；比较个人/朋友/Public 标识；让一个离线 Cairn 联网同步。
CAIRN06.expectedZh: 删除弹窗都有 X、Keep 和明确删除动作；两个入口样式一致；身份与受众一目了然；联网后无需刷新即开始同步。

HOME04.ownerObservation: The Last Hike card improved but the extra Open box felt wrong because the whole card was already tappable.
HOME04.rootCause: A nested affordance competed with the full-card interaction.
HOME04.fix: The card is one coherent tap target with no nested Open button.
HOME04.actionZh: 在 Home 点击 Last Hike 卡片的标题、数据和右侧区域。
HOME04.expectedZh: 整个卡片都进入同一详情；没有额外 Open 框或重复点击语义。

HOME01.ownerObservation: Debug retained obsolete controls; sunny artwork was too sharp; Privacy and Help felt outside the app's visual system.
HOME01.rootCause: Concluded experiments remained exposed and sunny/help surfaces had not fully converged on the locked Home family.
HOME01.fix: Obsolete distance/weather duplication was removed; a softened canonical sunny image was manifested; Cairn-native Privacy/Help layouts were preserved and validated.
HOME01.actionZh: 连续点 Settings 的 Thanks for using Cairn 五次，检查 Debug；切换晴天；打开 Privacy 和 Help/About。
HOME01.expectedZh: Debug 只保留有效工具；晴天山、水面和草地不过度锐利；Privacy/Help 的间距、颜色、按钮与 App 一致。

HOME02.ownerObservation: Reinstall resumed without login; Hike/Memory transition and Fog timing remained unsatisfactory; populated Memory took about 15 seconds.
HOME02.rootCause: Map readiness and Fog restoration needed separate state, while iOS Keychain intentionally preserves secure sessions across reinstall. The reported native populated-data cost cannot be represented by Web alone.
HOME02.fix: Readiness and Fog restoration remain separated with local-first composition and centered status. Performance was benchmarked, including one disclosed mixed-data regression. Session persistence was not silently redefined.
HOME02.actionZh: 在真机冷启动 Hike 和已填充的 Memory，录屏从地球层级进入以及 Fog 恢复耗时；另做一次删除重装并观察登录状态。
HOME02.expectedZh: 没有一闪而过或与标签重叠的 loading；地球到本地过渡连续；Fog 状态与内容顺序合理。删除重装后仍登录是当前 Keychain 设计，是否改成强制登录请由 Owner 明确决定。

AUTH01.ownerObservation: Sign-out/delete text wrapped awkwardly, leaned left, and field/button widths did not match.
AUTH01.rootCause: Settings auth dialogs and destructive layouts had inconsistent width and alignment rules.
AUTH01.fix: The Cairn-native dialog hierarchy uses close-to-cancel, one explicit action, aligned content, and shared widths.
AUTH01.actionZh: 在不同文字大小下打开 Sign out 和 Delete account 弹窗。
AUTH01.expectedZh: 文字换行自然且视觉居中；输入框与主按钮宽度一致；顶部 X 取消，下方只有当前主要动作。

END01.ownerObservation: The test case incorrectly expected reopening/resuming historical Activities; the product has no such requirement.
END01.rootCause: The test definition contradicted the product contract.
END01.fix: No historical-resume feature was added. Completed Activities stay view-only.
END01.actionZh: 完成一个活动，随后从历史记录打开。
END01.expectedZh: 可以查看已完成活动，但没有 Resume/继续历史活动的动作；请将原 case 改为只读验证。

blockers: Owner numeric account ID is not present in the authority JSON.
A second isolated disposable actor and operator workflow have not been supplied/proven.
Native positive and negative walking-discovery cases are pending.
The local disposable MySQL integration harness could not run because Docker daemon availability failed.
